subject: POC trial: Observability roadmap, success criteria & ownership
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@clearsight.ai>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-20T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap — POC goals & next steps

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps for the 3-week trial/POC so we have alignment before the technical kickoff:

Goals / success criteria (proposed):
- Latency: p50 token latency ≤ 220ms for 512-token prompts under steady load (10 rps).
- Cost: per-token unit cost <= target you provided (you said ~$0.0008/token; we will measure actual).
- Reliability: 99% of inference requests complete without model fallback or error during test window.
- Observability: real-time dashboards for request rate, latency buckets, model fallback count, and per-route token counts; traces for request paths with KV cache hit/miss breakdown.

Data/access ask before kickoff:
- Sandbox API key / endpoint for us to push test traffic (Tom or procurement can provide).
- Sample prompt set (10–15 prompts) + 3 production traffic patterns (burst, steady, low).

Proposed timeline:
- This week: exchange sandbox credentials and sample prompts.
- Mon (May 25): technical kickoff (30–45m) with engineering + observability owners.
- May 26–June 11: 3-week trial execution + daily talley at end of day for first 3 days.
- June 12: finish, share evaluation report vs success criteria.

Owners:
- Redwood: Neha (overall), Rishi (technical onboarding & instrumentation), Monica (customer success / eval coordination).
- ClearSight: Elena (PM, evaluation owner), Tom (engineering lead).

Attachments: POC outline (clearsight_poc_success_criteria.xlsx) sent with this note.

Can you confirm the success criteria above and whether the timeline works? If yes, we will send a calendar invite for Mon kickoff.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

---

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@clearsight.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@clearsight.ai>, procurement@clearsight.ai
Date: 2026-05-21T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — POC goals & next steps

Thanks Neha — this looks good and aligns with our expectations. A few clarifications and small edits to the success criteria:

- Latency target: we suggest p95 ≤ 420ms (p50 is useful but our consumers care more about tail latency). Can Redwood provide both p50 and p95 in dashboards?
- Cost: yes, we want per-token breakdown by route (chat vs generation) so we can compute net billable unit cost.
- Observability: add error rate by model variant and a per-request trace id that ties logs -> trace -> dashboard.

We will provide:
- Sandbox API key by end of day Tue (procurement looping in).
- Prompt set and traffic profiles in the attached workbook (telemetry_sample_spec.xlsx).

Can you confirm that Redwood can export request logs to our S3 bucket (we can give a write-only prefix)? Also want to see an example dashboard prior to kickoff if possible.

Elena
Product Manager | ClearSight Analytics
elena.rossi@clearsight.ai

---

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@clearsight.ai>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-22T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — POC goals & next steps

Hi Elena / Tom —

Short note from the engineering side: yes, we can provide both p50 and p95 latency on the dashboard, plus per-route cost breakdowns. A few implementation notes ahead of kickoff:

1) S3 log export: we support periodic log dumps and near-real-time export (putObject) to a customer bucket with a write-only prefix. Please share the bucket ARN + prefix and a short-lived IAM role or bucket policy and we will validate.

2) Trace correlation: we will emit a trace_id header on each request. Our instrumentation guide (redwood_poc-instrumentation-guide.pdf) explains how to map trace_id -> request_id -> session in your systems.

3) Dashboard sample: I will upload a sample dashboard to the shared drive and attach a lightweight telemetry spec (telemetry_sample_spec.xlsx).

For the kickoff, please include the person who will own the S3 bucket and someone from infra to confirm access.

-Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_poc-instrumentation-guide.pdf

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@clearsight.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@clearsight.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-24T08:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — POC goals & next steps

Thanks Rishi — procurement just sent the sandbox credentials (see below). Tom will be the infra contact for the S3 bucket.

Credentials:
- API key: sk-live-sandbox-XXXX (sent via secure portal)
- S3 bucket: arn:aws:s3:::clearsight-poc-logs (prefix: redwood/put/)

Elena's clarified success metrics (from attached workbook):
- Functional accept: 90% of prompts meet correctness scoring threshold (we'll share grading rubric).
- Latency: p95 < 420ms during steady load; p50 target 200–250ms.
- Observability: dashboards must include
  - Requests per second (by route)
  - Latency histogram (p50/p90/p95)
  - Error rate (4xx/5xx) and model fallback count
  - KV cache hit ratio and per-session memory footprint
  - Trace sampling: 1% full-trace, 100% header propagation for correlation

Availability for kickoff: Mon May 25 at 10:00am PT works for our team.

Elena

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@clearsight.ai>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-28T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — POC goals & next steps

Elena / Tom —

Appreciate the confirmations and the sandbox creds. Below is the final POC observability roadmap and immediate next steps from Redwood's side. We have scheduled the kickoff for Mon May 25 10:00am PT (calendar invite sent).

Redwood observability roadmap (POC):
- Day 0 (kickoff): verify API key + S3 write access; confirm trace_id propagation and sampling policy.
- Days 1–3 (instrumentation & validation): push sample traffic; validate KV cache behavior; enable continuous batching with monitoring.
- Ongoing (weeks 1–3):
  - Dashboards: live dashboards for RPS, latency histograms (p50/p90/p95), error rate, fallback count, token consumption by route, and KV cache hit ratio.
  - Tracing: we will propagate trace_id header and provide sampled spans (1% full-trace) to link logs -> traces -> dashboards.
  - Log export: hourly batches to your S3 prefix; we will include request_id, trace_id, model_variant, route, tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_ms, error_code.
  - Alerts: preconfigured alerts for p95 latency > 500ms, error rate > 2% over 5m, and model fallback spike > 3/min.

Deliverables & ownership:
- Redwood: sample dashboard (by kickoff) [owner: Rishi], instrumentation guide (attached), daily onboarding notes for first 3 days [owner: Monica], final evaluation report with metrics vs success criteria [owner: Neha].
- ClearSight: provide sample prompts, traffic profiles, S3 bucket access, and grading rubric for correctness scoring [owner: Elena/Tom].

Evaluation plan & timeline:
- Data collection window: May 25 + 3 weeks (ends June 15).
- Interim check-ins: daily standup for first 3 days; weekly sync on Wed afternoons.
- Final report: June 16 deliverable comparing live metrics to success criteria and recommended next steps (model variant recommendations, quantization/cost levers).

Next steps (action items):
1) ClearSight to confirm S3 write policy and share bucket policy by EOD Tue (Elena/Tom).
2) Redwood to upload sample dashboard to shared drive by kickoff (Rishi).
3) Both teams: tech kickoff Mon May 25 10:00am PT (calendar invite in your inbox).

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/clearsight/CS-2026-042
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-clearsight-poc

I will follow up after the kickoff with the instrumentation checklist and the SOW/DocuSign for signature if you want the formal trial agreement in place.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to a smooth kickoff.

Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Attachments: redwood_poc-instrumentation-guide.pdf, clearsight_poc_success_criteria.xlsx
